queries: Sundar Pichai hallucination "inherent feature" Verge Decoder interview
Google AI Overviews about last week May 2024

sources_considered.why: Primary interview transcript with Pichai's own words on hallucination.
Reports OpenAI's 2024 loss expectation from documents seen by the NYT and confirmed by CNBC.
Google's own admission that AI Overviews showed inaccurate answers in May 2024.
Later OpenAI research post; context and partial counterevidence on whether errors are unavoidable.
Speaker's own writing; cannot be cited as evidence he was right.

receipt.public_excerpt: But OpenAI sees a loss of $5 billion, which doesn’t include equity-based compensation, the Times said.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI, the leading generative AI company, expected to lose about $5 billion in 2024. That fits 'unprofitable'.

metric_scope.metric: Net loss (excluding equity-based compensation), company projection

evidence_items.locator: Pichai answer on 'Check this info' disclaimers

receipt.public_excerpt: You’re getting at a deeper point where hallucination is still an unsolved problem. In some ways, it’s an inherent feature.

evidence_items.explanation: Google's CEO said in May 2024 that hallucination was unsolved and in some ways inherent. This matches the quote Zitron gave and backs the 'persistent error problem' part.

receipt.public_excerpt: But some odd, inaccurate or unhelpful AI Overviews certainly did show up.

evidence_items.explanation: Google admitted that its AI search answers showed inaccurate results in May 2024. This backs the claim about wrong answers in Google Search.

receipt.public_excerpt:
Claim: Hallucinations are inevitable.
Finding: They are not, because language models can abstain when uncertain.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI later argued that hallucinations can be avoided by letting models abstain. The same post says hallucinations 'remain a fundamental challenge for all large language models'. This cuts against the strongest reading of 'unassailable', but it is from 2025, outside the target period.

unresolved_gaps: OpenAI's 2024 loss figure is a projection from investor documents reported by the press, not an audited filing.
'Unsustainable' is a judgment about the future and is not tested.
Profitability of generative AI units inside big tech firms is not disclosed.
